title: Commit your way to the Lord

request.style: English, warm female solo voice, acoustic guitar, piano, cello, soft strings, 80 BPM
request.lyrics:
[Verse]
Like grass they will soon wither
Fade like the green of new growth
Trust in the Lord and do good
Dwell in the land with grace

[Verse]
Make faithfulness your pasture
Delight in the Lord alone
He will give what your heart asks
When you walk in his ways

[Chorus]
Commit your way to the Lord
Trust in him and he will act
Bring out your righteousness
Like the light of day

[Verse]
Be still before the Lord
Wait patiently for him
Do not burn with anger
Over the man who prospers

[Chorus]
Commit your way to the Lord
Trust in him and he will act
Bring out your righteousness
Like the light of day

[Bridge]
Your justice like the noonday sun
Shining clear and true
Let go of anger now
Abandon wrath and fear

[Chorus]
Commit your way to the Lord
Trust in him and he will act
Bring out your righteousness
Like the light of day

[Outro]
It leads only to evil
So trust in him alone
